registration.statement: A complete molecular state retains spin, orbital and rotational support with two opposed orientations as held labels. Equal complementary support closes to structural EmptyOne; unmatched support retains a positive count and its generating orientation. Molecular moment is the exact positive response count per positive angular recurrence, and susceptibility is the exact positive induced response per positive applied-field act. All 174 NIST g-factor and magnetic-susceptibility cells seal without their values or orientations before the 136 printed magnitudes and 38 blanks open. No fitted g-factor, continuum derivative or species coefficient enters.
